cmd:
bash -c 
echo "=== 1. Shadow active count ==="
docker exec gpay-postgres-shadow sh -c "psql -U \"\$POSTGRES_USER\" -d \"\$POSTGRES_DB\" -tAc \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shadow_traitestpbs.payment_bills WHERE NOT COALESCE(_deleted, false);\""
echo "=== 2. Master count (payment_bills & payment_bills_1) ==="
docker exec gpay-postgres-dest sh -c "psql -U \"\$POSTGRES_USER\" -d \"\$POSTGRES_DB\" -tAc \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM master_payment_bill_service.payment_bills; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM master_payment_bill_service.payment_bills_1;\""
echo "=== 3. Sample row from shadow_traitestpbs.payment_bills ==="
docker exec gpay-postgres-shadow sh -c "psql -U \"\$POSTGRES_USER\" -d \"\$POSTGRES_DB\" -c \"SELECT _gpay_id, _source_id, _source_ts FROM shadow_traitestpbs.payment_bills WHERE NOT COALESCE(_deleted, false) ORDER BY _gpay_id DESC LIMIT 3;\""
echo "=== 4. Matching rows in master_payment_bill_service.payment_bills ==="
docker exec gpay-postgres-dest sh -c "psql -U \"\$POSTGRES_USER\" -d \"\$POSTGRES_DB\" -c \"SELECT _gpay_id, _id, _source_ts FROM master_payment_bill_service.payment_bills ORDER BY _gpay_id DESC LIMIT 3;\""
